title: CI test assumes walrus despite configured chair host
body: what: test_pin_unpin_family fails when chair host is configured to a non-walrus machine. where: jeeves/tests/test_chair_commands_020.py:275. evidence: build-jeeves failed at this assertion on PR #9681; rerunning the test on base SHA 18738ede also fails with the output showing the configured host instead of walrus. fix: set the test fixture chair host explicitly to walrus or assert the configured host.
